title: FIFA, PSC sign $25 million deal for Rizal Memorial Stadium rehabilitation, training centers construction
summary: The Philippine's football infrastructure has received another boost from the sport’s governing body after FIFA lent a hand to give a new look to the Rizal Memorial Stadium.
